shouldFix.title: The finding disposition invents an id for the predecessor Codex finding that the source deliberately left unlabeled
shouldFix.finding: The frozen sdk leftover-join.v7 Codex review has one shouldFix object whose keys are evidence, fields, finding, identifierInvented, repairShape, severity, title, and whyShouldFix. It has no id member, and identifierInvented is false. sdk leftover-join.v8 adds findingDisposition[0].id = `unlabeledCodexShouldFix` while describing the same source finding as `UNLABELED`. That id is not supplied by the frozen source and therefore invents exactly the finding identifier the prompt forbids.
evidence: sdk-leftover-join.v7.review-independent.codex.json shouldFix has length 1 and shouldFix[0] has no id key.
The same source item records identifierInvented false.
sdk-leftover-join.v8.json findingDisposition[0] has keys disposition, id, landedAt, and severity; its id value is `unlabeledCodexShouldFix`.
The disposition string itself begins `UNLABELED`, so the new id conflicts with the recorded source standing even though the substantive repair landed correctly.
shouldFix.whyShouldFix: The new id creates false review provenance for a frozen source and breaks mechanical distinction between source-assigned identifiers and successor-local labels. It does not alter either leftover set, row standing, authority boundary, or the substance of the repaired summary, so this is a SHOULD-FIX rather than a MUST-FIX.
shouldFix.repairShape: In a frozen successor, carry the disposition descriptively with no id member. It may state sourceReview as the unlabeled Codex sdk leftover-join.v7 SHOULD-FIX, retain its title and landedAt, and explicitly record identifierMintedByThisLineage false. Keep summary.specifiedNotLeftover and summary.leftoverDesign unchanged; do not remasure g20 leftover-join.v11 or alter either lineage's remainder.

reviewSummary: REJECT at zero MUST-FIX and one SHOULD-FIX. Subject and frozen-predecessor custody hold; HEAD is D-328, required-now is 28, every cited digest and review standing reproduces, the v7 summary omission is substantively repaired, sdk leftover-join.v6 remains the current recorded DR-125 consumer until successor adoption, OBL-SDK-API-RESERVED remains the sole DR-125 leftover-design member, and OBL-G20-FX-AUTHORING remains untouched on frozen g20 leftover-join.v11 / DR-G20. The remaining defect is provenance: findingDisposition[0] gives the explicitly unlabeled v7 Codex SHOULD-FIX the invented id `unlabeledCodexShouldFix`.
